sloka: मानमस्ति महारा ज राजभावात् क्षमान्वित ।किंचिद् आत्ययिकम् कार्यम् तेषाम् त्वम् दर्शनम् कुरु ।। ६-३२-३७।।
transliteration: mānamasti mahārā ja rājabhāvāt kṣamānvita ।kiṁcid ātyayikam kāryam teṣām tvam darśanam kuru ।। 6-32-37।।

translations.english: "O great king, endowed with forgiveness and royalty! there is a little urgent work. Undoubtedly, they are waiting to see you please."
